slash_moon.description: Moonshadow Assassin dash slash — purple-white crescent. Rotate to dash direction (frame faces right).

slash_holy.description: Holy Bulwark sacred blade slash — gold crescent. Rotate to swing direction.

hit_spark.description: Generic impact spark for hits/crits. Tint-free; draw at hit point.

explosion_fire.description: Fire explosion — meteor, explosive barrel, Hellfire soul burst, supernova (scale up).

explosion_hellfire.description: Demon Lord hellfire burst — orange-black flame. Soul explosion / Gate of Inferno.

lightning_strike.description: Lightning strike from sky; anchor is the ground impact point (bottom).

ice_nova.description: Frost nova ring with 8 shards. Shatter reaction / Absolute Zero.

magic_circle_gold.description: Looping gold rune circle — Sanctum Saint sigil, Rite of the Seven Sins base, portals. Draw on ground and squash Y by ISO_TILT (0.68) for 2.5D floor look.

magic_circle_crimson.description: Looping crimson rune circle — Vampire / Demon rituals, cursed statues. Draw on ground and squash Y by ISO_TILT (0.68) for 2.5D floor look.

holy_pillar.description: Pillar of light from sky — Judgement Pillar, Saint ultimate finisher. Anchor = ground.

blood_burst.description: Blood splatter — bleed pop, Crimson Feast drink, Blood Pact.

void_vortex.description: Looping dark vortex — black hole, Gluttony maw, Sloth time field, portals.

heal_sparkle.description: Looping rising + sparkles — regen zones, flower field, sanctum heal. Anchor = feet.
